note: Patcher matrix for B190. BUILT FROM main AT 94bcf83 (PR #350). B190 exists for ONE defect: the spa lounger orientation (#330), on its SIXTH attempt. The owner playtested B189, photographed the villager still lying ACROSS the lounger, and diagnosed it directly: flip the villager orientation horizontally for the spa receiving actions. WHY FIVE EARLIER ROUNDS COULD NOT HAVE WORKED. Every one of them argued about WHICH orientation takes WHICH strip -- northeast versus northwest -- and B189 added a handle gate so the spa rule could not reach ordinary chaises. All of that tunes a SELECTOR. The receiving pose needs the MIRROR of whatever that selector picks, so both placements were wrong together and tuning the selector could only swap which one looked wrong. The 'one lounger correct, one wrong' symptom on B188 was TWO STACKED DEFECTS: the selector wrong for one placement, on top of the mirror wrong for both. THE FIX IS SCOPED TO VF2PlanSpaTreatment, the receiving pose. Head, body and sleep strip all take the opposite arm together, so the settle and the sleep cannot disagree. The giving villager plans no pose at all (PlanToWork only), and the two chaise relax poses plus every ordinary and mobile Lounge Chair keep the facing the owner confirmed working. B189's handle gate is UNCHANGED and still correct; it was never the problem, it simply could not fix a defect living in the mirror. SEEDED FROM B189, so the Exercise Bike (0x99) and Ping-Pong Table (0x9a) content maps are inherited. A seed predating them would drop that art silently while the build still reported success. NOT PLAYTESTED AT BUILD TIME. 115 tests pass and three mutations are caught -- body un-mirrored, head un-mirrored, strip not mirrored -- but no check on the artifact can verify this fix: it is a compare constant in compiled code, and SleepNE/SleepNW appear in every executable regardless of which orientation selects which. Issue #330 stays open until the owner confirms both loungers in play.
